title: Two-Number Calculator
description:
**Goal:** Show every arithmetic result for two integers.
```
Enter two integers: 17 5
17 + 5 = 22
17 - 5 = 12
17 * 5 = 85
17 / 5 = 3 (integer)
17 / 5 = 3.4 (decimal)
17 % 5 = 2
```
requirements: Read both with one `cin >> a >> b`
Show both integer and decimal division
stretch: write a function for each operation.
